observations: Real New B and New E, R1 empty, R2 occupied, R3 empty, 10 s each. The New E label denotes the pink E. Geometry is used only after the unscored results are saved.
apply: Reuse the New A and subsequent B/C/D implementations unchanged. Process each initialization with its own R1. G2 is the single-triplet baseline. Four-group fusion is the unweighted mean of the normalized G1-G4 spectra, without coherent stitching. The raw and R1 per-frequency effective-reference variants are both shown for every site.
direction_rule: Full-grid strongest spatial MUSIC peak, -90 to +90 in 3 deg steps. For additional background peaks use the inherited threshold from reference-only data, both halves and >=3/4 time windows. Compare R1 and R3 reference variants, within 9 deg, keep all matches and veto those also found in the other empty record. R1 is the main reference; swapping is a sensitivity check.
controls: Constant/linear and empirical reference scores checked on R3; require support >=0.80 and P90 <=15 degrees per chain pair. Corroboration on a known off-axis active source is missing. A responsive empty/occupied contrast alone does not establish the reflector direction.
repeat_hypothesis: Check whether the previous B C1 empirical -63 degree branch repeats as R2 dominant peak or within the controls; do not switch subarray or promote secondary peaks based on theory. G3 empirical result from A is also an existing direction hypothesis.
summary: Use most recent matched acquisition per point: New A, Real New B, Real New C, Real New D, New E. Earlier New B and New C are separate repeats. Never select the run closest to truth. One occupied visit per batch; subwindows are not new visits.
data_audit: Verify raw manifests, SHA256 distinctness, frequency, target frames, formal-window gaps and all per-state visit coverage. Account for lost frames without imputing. Write separate outputs and keep all old files intact.
